complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Design and Document Core Data Models
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the data model design into separate subtasks for each core interface/class: Unit model definition, Attack model with damage calculation logic, TargetingRule interface design, CharacterSheet with base stats structure, and CombatStats derivation system with relationships documentation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to foundational nature affecting entire system architecture. Requires careful design of relationships, inheritance patterns, and extensibility. Multiple interconnected models need precise definition.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement Unit Factory and Registry System
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into: UnitFactory class implementation with creation methods, UnitRegistry system for storing unit templates, AttackRegistry for attack definitions, and unit type constants/enums with validation logic.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate-high complexity involving design patterns and registry management. Requires proper abstraction and error handling, but follows established factory pattern principles.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into: CharacterSheet class with base stats storage, stat derivation calculation methods, unit-specific stat presets definition, and extensible stat modification system.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium complexity with mathematical calculations and stat relationships. Straightforward implementation but requires careful formula design and extensibility planning.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break into: TargetingEngine class structure, individual targeting rule implementations (front, right, etc.), position-based battlefield logic, TargetingRule interface with execution methods, and edge case handling for invalid targets.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to spatial logic and multiple targeting patterns. Requires robust position calculation and extensible rule system design.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into: Bear unit with Slash attack implementation, Tiger unit with Pounce attack implementation, and Eagle unit with Swoop attack implementation, each with distinct stats and targeting integration.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-low complexity as it applies existing systems. Repetitive implementation across three similar units with different parameters and attacks.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into: Goober unit class implementation with base stats, and Slam attack integration with targeting system validation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Low-medium complexity as it's a single unit following established patterns. Straightforward implementation using existing factory and targeting systems.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement Combat Logic and Turn Management
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down into: CombatEngine class structure, initiative-based turn order calculation, attack execution and damage application logic, missed attack handling with unit repositioning, combat state management, and victory/defeat condition detection.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity as the core orchestration system. Manages complex state transitions, turn order logic, and integrates all other combat systems. Critical for game functionality.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into: RunManager/GameInitializer class implementation, and default team composition setup with proper unit positioning and combat system integration.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Low-medium complexity using existing factory systems. Straightforward initialization logic with minimal business rules.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Update Combat UI to Display Attack Names
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into: character card component updates for attack name display, data binding from unit attack properties to UI, and responsive design adjustments for different screen sizes.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-low complexity involving UI updates and data binding. Requires frontend component modification but follows established UI patterns.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement Dev-Only Unit and Attack Preview Panel
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break into: dev panel component creation with unit/attack listing, environment-based visibility toggle implementation, and formatted output display for debugging information.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Medium-low complexity as a development tool. Requires data aggregation and display logic but no complex business rules.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into: unit factory and registry test suites, character sheet calculation tests, targeting system test coverage, combat engine turn management tests, and mock setup for UI component isolation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Moderate-high complexity requiring comprehensive test coverage across multiple systems. Needs mocking strategies and edge case identification.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into: end-to-end combat scenario testing, acceptance criteria validation suite, component integration verification, and performance/responsiveness testing.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity requiring coordination of all system components. Involves both automated and manual testing strategies with performance considerations.
